title: Tyriq Plummer - Roguelikes and Platformers
speaker: Tyriq Plummer
description:
Tyriq Plumme talks about the influence of roguelike mechanics on platformers.
This video is from the 2017 Roguelike Celebration: https://roguelike.club/event2017.html
